{{Quote|Lowbacca was the only one who completely understood the biomechanics of the ''Maledoth''. So as you can see, the Ramoan relocation project has ground to a complete standstill.|The Jedi [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], to other senior Jedi Masters|<ref name="JK" />}}
The '''Ramoan relocation project''' was an effort organized by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]<ref name="JK" /> [[35 ABY/Legends|six years]] after<ref name="ERC" /> the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="JK" /> The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="FJO">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref> [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Ramoan]] was left without a homeworld following the war,<ref name="CER">{{CSWECite|III|77|Ramoan}}</ref> and therefore the entire population was planned to be relocated from their [[Ramoa|dying world]]. The [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] had been hoping to use a former [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[slaveship]], the ''[[Maledoth]]'', to accomplish this purpose, however, [[Lowbacca]], the only one who completely understood the biomechanics of the vessel, along with other young Jedi Knights abruptly abandoning their duties and departing for the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="JK" /> 

Without Lowbacca, the project came to a complete standstill, and the resulting chaos had to be dealt with by several senior Jedi Masters, including [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and [[Kyp Durron]].<ref name="JK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ramoan relocation project was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', which was written by [[Troy Denning]]<ref name="JK" /> and released in [[2005]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref>
